unresolved_layers.boundary: The 2025–2030 implementation plan has an official KPI-based PDCA framework and a 2025年度改訂版 was published in March 2026, but a separate canonical completed annual-result package for the current cycle has not been resolved. Source-inventory coverage is complete at the current official publication depth; this distinction remains a Phase 13 record-level evidence boundary, and prior 2020–2024 cycle results must not be substituted.

quality_boundary: Source-inventory coverage is complete at the maximum current official publication depth: the current basic plan, current 2025–2030 implementation plan and its revised publication route, official PDCA governance, fiscal 2026 budget, and fiscal 2024 settlement are identified. A separate completed annual-result package for the current implementation cycle remains unresolved and is carried into Phase 13 as an explicit evidence boundary. The inventory does not substitute the prior implementation cycle for current annual progress or promote KPI, project, budget, settlement, governance, or outcome records to Reviewed, linked, comparable, causal, or policy-achievement status.
next_action: Enter Phase 13 record review using the verified current basic-plan, implementation-plan, revised-plan and PDCA routes; resolve a distinct completed annual-result package if published, then review KPI definitions, implementation projects, fiscal-plan records, fiscal 2026 budget records, and fiscal 2024 settlement evidence at record level while preserving the 2020–2024 versus 2025–2030 cycle boundary.
